summary: Backend testing of Community Highlight redesign (singular /api/community-highlight + /api/community-highlights/top). 11/12 new tests PASS, 1 SKIPPED due to seed-data gap. All 10 iteration_18 regression tests still pass (community-feed, likes, comments, plural community-highlights trending landmarks, photo-of-week, landmark-community-photos).

minor.issue: source='custom' cannot be surfaced with current seed data AND there is a latent code gap: _build_candidate_pool uses mongo query {'photos':{'$exists':True,'$ne':[]}} for user_created_visits BEFORE falling back to landmarks[].photo (community.py:1025-1029 & 1123-1128). Any custom visit whose only photos live inside landmarks[].photo will be pre-filtered out, so the fallback logic is unreachable for those documents. Either loosen the query to {'$or':[{'photos':{'$ne':[]}},{'landmarks.photo':{'$ne':None}}]} or always pass and drop later via the existing photo_url!=None filter at line 1151.

visited_at is serialized to isoformat string in the candidate; tiebreak sort uses it as string which works only because all dates include timezone suffix of same length. Consider sorting by datetime before serialization for safety.

action_items: (Minor) Fix _build_candidate_pool to include custom visits whose only photos live in landmarks[].photo (see community.py:1025-1029). Current query pre-filters those out.

(Seed) Add a public user_created_visit with a non-empty photos array OR a landmarks[].photo set — this will allow the skipped test 'test_custom_visits_included_with_source_custom' to actually validate source='custom' rotation + top listing.
(Nice-to-have) Consider secondary sort by datetime object (not iso string) in /community-highlights/top.
critical_code_review_comments: community.py is 1229 lines — approaching/over the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting highlight endpoints into routes/community_highlights.py.
Same hotness computation is duplicated twice in _build_candidate_pool for visits and custom_visits (~20 lines each). Extract a helper _score(visit_doc, now, user_map, ...).
random.choice on hotness-sorted top-20 is fine, but two back-to-back callers could get same pick; acceptable per design. Document this in endpoint docstring.
No upper-bound protection on likes.find/comments.aggregate in _build_candidate_pool — currently fine because limited upstream to 200+100 activities, but worth an explicit comment.

is_liked on the SINGLE /community-highlight is computed with find_one + count_documents — two separate DB round-trips per request. With 200 candidates already aggregated, consider reusing aggregated likes/comments maps built during scoring to avoid the extra round-trip (minor perf).
Error handling: no try/except around endpoints; a mongo hiccup returns 500. Consider wrapping with structured error response consistent with rest of the API.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 active, 1 skipped due to seed gap)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_19 validates the new singular /api/community-highlight endpoint and /api/community-highlights/top endpoint. All core contracts verified: required fields, rotation across calls, rank ordering, limit param, like/comment side-effect reflection, and regressions for community-feed & plural community-highlights. One skipped test (test_custom_visits_included_with_source_custom) needs seed data with a public user_created_visit having a non-empty photos array. Endpoints are under /app/backend/routes/community.py lines 1012-1226. No frontend testing performed (out of scope). For future runs, the test file at /app/backend/tests/test_community_highlight_iteration19.py is reusable as a regression suite.
rca of the issue: Skipped test RCA: DB has 3 public user_created_visits with empty photos=[] and null landmarks[].photo. The mongo query in _build_candidate_pool filters on photos!=[] BEFORE the fallback to landmarks[].photo, making the fallback unreachable for docs with empty photos. Two remediations: (a) seed a custom visit with photos populated, (b) widen the query to include docs where landmarks[].photo exists. Reproduction: `GET /api/community-highlights/top?limit=50` — response items never contain source='custom'.
